text:
Avery Lopez: Hi everyone 44b Im Avery, joining today as a Product Engineer on the embeddings team. Quick intro + setup thread. Im US-PST, planning to be on the SF floor next Wednesday. Two tiny things: can someone add me to the internal embeddings repo? Im also unsure whether to enroll in the laptop pool or use my personal ThinkPad for early work. Fun fact challenge: I once taught a parrot to say the company name.

Nora Kim: welcome avery!! :tada: adding you to the team channel. For laptops, IT usually asks folks to request via the portal if youm doing heavy model runs. If youm just hacking on prompts, personal is fine for first week. I609

IT Support: Hi Avery 44b Please file a request at https://redwood.internal/it-requests (choose "Access" + "Hardware"). If you share your GitHub handle we can pre-stage repo invites. Yubikeys are available at the SF front desk.

Avery Lopez: GitHub handle is avery-lopez. I tried a quick clone and got an auth error, heres what happened:

```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/embeddings-core.git
Cloning into 'embeddings-core'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

Anyone got a one-liner fix while I open the ticket?

Benji Ortiz: try `ssh -T git@github.com` to see if your key is loaded. On mac/linux, `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` often does it. If youre on Windows, use the pageant/WSL flow. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Onboarder Bot: Welcome Avery Lopez! Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist created. Next: schedule 30m intro with team in the #eng-calendar.

Samir Gupta: hey avery, congrats! If you want to run small embedding tests locally, I can share a pre-built docker image and a tiny sample dataset. Also we keep some spare M1 laptops in SF if youre weighing options.

Avery Lopez: thanks all 60a I49b booked the hardware form and pasted my ssh pub key in the ticket. Will take Benji up on the call if the one-liner fails. Also yes, I will absolutely come to SF next Wed for the parrot story & lunch 37d (spoiler: the parrot only says part of the name).
